biography: Born in Modena, Italy, amidst the roar of engines and the scent of burning rubber, Teo Fabi's fate was sealed from a young age. His father, a mechanic for a small touring car team, instilled in him a love for speed and precision. Teo began karting at the age of 8, quickly displaying an aggressive, uncompromising style that both thrilled and terrified his competitors. A defining moment came at the regional karting championship when, despite starting last due to a mechanical issue, he clawed his way to victory with a daring last-corner overtake that became legendary in local racing circles. This raw talent and relentless ambition caught the eye of United Racing, who signed him to their junior formula program. After a season in Formula Ford, he stepped up to Formula 3, demonstrating flashes of brilliance. Now at 23, driving for WeiBbier/Petrocelli Racing in the Reynard 95i Ford, Teo is seen as a rising star, though his impetuousness sometimes leads to costly mistakes. However, if he learns to harness his aggression, the future could be very bright indeed.
drivingStyle: Teo's driving style can be described as 'controlled chaos.' He is known for his late-braking maneuvers and willingness to push the car to its absolute limit, often flirting with the edge of control. He attacks corners with ferocious intent, frequently using every inch of the track, and sometimes a bit more. While his tire management could use improvement, especially in longer races, his ability to handle pressure is remarkable. When faced with a challenge, Teo digs deep, finding an extra gear that few others possess. This 'never give up' attitude, combined with his raw speed, makes him a formidable opponent.

rivalries.reason: A clash of personalities. Dubois, a calculated and methodical driver, constantly criticizes Fabi's aggressive style, leading to heated exchanges both on and off the track.
A battle for supremacy in the junior formula ranks. They traded wins and championships, creating a fierce rivalry that continues to this day.
Moretti, known for her defensive driving, has repeatedly blocked Fabi's overtaking attempts, leading to frustration and accusations of unfair tactics from Teo.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of racing gloves, even if they are falling apart.
Listens to Italian opera at full volume on his headphones right before the race to 'get into the zone'.
Always has a shot of espresso 15 minutes before getting into the car.
famousQuote: "Second place is just the first loser. I race to win, and I'll do whatever it takes to get there."
careerHighlight: Winning the 1998 Formula Ford championship after a season-long battle, securing his first major title in motorsport.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the 1999 Formula 3 season finale due to an overambitious overtaking attempt, costing him the championship.
